                end
            end
            
            -- B. FONT LOGIC (Applies to all texts)

                local font = LSM:Fetch("font", cfg.globalFont)
                if font then
                    -- Helper to apply font keeping size/flags
                    local function SetFont(fs)
                        if fs and fs.SetFont and fs.GetFont then
                            local _, size, flags = fs:GetFont()
                            fs:SetFont(font, size, flags)
                        end

trigger.custom:
function(event, ...)
    local CB = _G.HunterCB
    if not CB then return false end
    
    -- Load Config to check options
    local cfg = _G.TBCHunterConfig or {}
    
    -- 1. COMBAT LOG HANDLER (Starts the bars)
    if event == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        local timestamp, subevent, _, sourceGUID, sourceName, _, _, destGUID, destName, _, _, spellID, spellName = CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo()
        
        if sourceGUID ~= UnitGUID("player") then return false end
        
        -- A. CAST START
        if subevent == "SPELL_CAST_START" then
            local name, _, icon, castTime = GetSpellInfo(spellID)
            
            -- Check for Auto Shot or Multi-Shot
            local isAuto = CB.IsSpellID(spellID, CB.spellIDs.autoShot)
            local isMulti = CB.IsSpellID(spellID, CB.spellIDs.multiShot)
            
            if isAuto or isMulti then
                
                -- === OPTION CHECKS ===
                -- If Auto Shot is disabled in options, stop here
                if isAuto and cfg.enableAutoShotBar == false then return false end
                
                -- If Multi-Shot is disabled in options, stop here
                if isMulti and cfg.enableMultiShotBar == false then return false end
                -- =====================
                
                if castTime and castTime > 0 then
                    local duration = castTime / 1000
                    CB.StartCast(name, duration, icon, spellID)
                    
                    -- Safety Timer (Auto-cleanup at theoretical end)
                    C_Timer.After(duration + 0.1, function()
                            if CB.spell == name then
                                CB.StopCast()
                                WeakAuras.ScanEvents("HUNTER_CB_UPDATE")
                            end
                    end)
                    
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        
        -- B. CAST SUCCESS (Ensure bar stays visible)
        if subevent == "SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS" then
            if CB.active and CB.spellID then
                -- If it's our tracked spell, force visibility
                if CB.IsSpellID(CB.spellID, CB.spellIDs.autoShot) or CB.IsSpellID(CB.spellID, CB.spellIDs.multiShot) then
                    return true 
                end
                -- If another spell succeeded somehow, stop ours
                CB.StopCast()
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- 2. REAL INTERRUPTION (Movement, Stopcasting, etc.)
    if event == "UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED" then
        local unit = select(1, ...)
        if unit == "player" then
            if CB.active then
                CB.StopCast()
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- 3. UPDATE CHECK
    if event == "HUNTER_CB_UPDATE" then
        return CB.active and CB.endTime > GetTime()
    end
    
    return CB.active and CB.endTime > GetTime()
end

        return r1, g1, b1, a1
    end

    local speed = UnitRangedDamage("player")
    local mode = cfg.rotLogicMode or 1
    
    -- === NEW: DYNAMIC LOGIC (MODE 3) ===
    if mode == 3 then
        local unit = "target"
        
        -- Default to Standard (1)
        mode = 1 
        
        if UnitExists(unit) and not UnitIsDead(unit) and UnitCanAttack("player", unit) then
            -- Check melee/sweet spot range using Item ID 8149
            local inMeleeOrSweetSpot = IsItemInRange("item:8149", unit)
            
            -- Switch to Melee Weaving (2) if in range
            if inMeleeOrSweetSpot == 1 or inMeleeOrSweetSpot == true then
                mode = 2
            end
        end
    end
    -- ==============================================
    
    -- Fetch the global table we shared earlier
    local tierTable = _G.TBCHunterRotationLogic and _G.TBCHunterRotationLogic[mode]
    if not tierTable then 
        return r1, g1, b1, a1 
    end
    
    -- 3. Find the Active Breakpoint
    local activeTier = tierTable[#tierTable]
    for _, t in ipairs(tierTable) do
        if speed > t.val then
            activeTier = t
            break
        end
    end
    
    -- 4. Color Handling
    local r, g, b = unpack(activeTier.defColor)
    
    if activeTier.colorKey and cfg[activeTier.colorKey] then
        r, g, b = unpack(cfg[activeTier.colorKey])
    end
    
    -- 5. Alpha Handling
    local finalAlpha = (a1 == 0) and 0 or 0.5
    
    return r, g, b, finalAlpha

    local cfg = _G.TBCHunterConfig or {}
    local speed = UnitRangedDamage("player")

        if UnitExists(unit) and not UnitIsDead(unit) and UnitCanAttack("player", unit) then

            -- If the item is in range (returns 1 or true), switch to Melee Weaving (2)
            if inMeleeOrSweetSpot == 1 or inMeleeOrSweetSpot == true then
                mode = 2
            end
        end
    end
    -- ==============================================
    
    -- Retrieve the correct logic table from aura_env
    local tierTable = aura_env.rotationLogic[mode] or aura_env.rotationLogic[1]
    
    -- 3. Find the Active Breakpoint (Tier)
    local activeTier = tierTable[#tierTable]
    
    for _, t in ipairs(tierTable) do
        if speed > t.val then
            activeTier = t
            break
        end
    end
    
    -- 4. Color Handling
    local r, g, b = unpack(activeTier.defColor)
    
    if activeTier.colorKey and cfg[activeTier.colorKey] then
        r, g, b = unpack(cfg[activeTier.colorKey])
    end
    
    local hex = string.format("ff%02x%02x%02x", r*255, g*255, b*255)
    
    -- 5. Text Label Handling

    if activeTier.textKey and cfg[activeTier.textKey] and cfg[activeTier.textKey] ~= "" then
        label = cfg[activeTier.textKey]
    end
    
    -- 6. Final Output Formatting
    local showSpeed = (cfg.showAttackSpeed ~= false)
    local showRot   = (cfg.showRotationText ~= false)

    elseif showSpeed then
        finalStr = string.format("%.2f", speed)
    elseif showRot then
        finalStr = label
    end
    
    return "|c" .. hex .. finalStr .. "|r"

function(event, ...)
    local now = GetTime()
    
    -- 1. COMBAT LOG HANDLER
    if event == "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED" then
        local _, subEvent, _, sourceGUID, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, spellID, spellName = CombatLogGetCurrentEventInfo()
        
        if sourceGUID == UnitGUID("player") then
            
            -- A. AUTO SHOT (RESET CYCLE)
            if subEvent == "SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS" and spellID == 75 then
                aura_env.lastAutoStart = now
                aura_env.autoSpeed = UnitRangedDamage("player")
                
                -- Clean reset
                aura_env.castWeaveActive = false 
                aura_env.tickPercent = -1
                return true
            end
            
            -- B. CAST START (CALCULATE TICK)
            if subEvent == "SPELL_CAST_START" then
                local nameMulti = GetSpellInfo(2643)
                local nameAimed = GetSpellInfo(19434)
                local nameSteady = GetSpellInfo(34120)
                
                local isWeavingSpell = false
                if spellName == nameMulti or spellName == nameAimed or spellName == nameSteady then 
                    isWeavingSpell = true 
                end
                
                if isWeavingSpell then
                    if not aura_env.lastAutoStart or aura_env.lastAutoStart == 0 then return false end
                    
                    local progress = now - aura_env.lastAutoStart
                    local castDuration = 0
                    
                    -- === HYBRID CALCULATION ===
                    if spellName == nameMulti then
                        -- Multi-Shot: Fixed 0.5s (Safe Method)
                        castDuration = 0.5
                    else
                        -- Steady/Aimed: Use API for exact Haste calculation
                        local _, _, _, startTime, endTime = UnitCastingInfo("player")
                        if startTime and endTime then
                            castDuration = (endTime - startTime) / 1000
                        else
                            -- Fallback
                            if spellName == nameAimed then castDuration = 3.0 end
                            if spellName == nameSteady then castDuration = 1.5 end
                        end
                    end
                    
                    -- === 3. CALCULATE POSITION ===
                    local finishTimeRelative = progress + castDuration
                    
                    if aura_env.autoSpeed and aura_env.autoSpeed > 0 then
                        local calculatedPercent = finishTimeRelative / aura_env.autoSpeed
                        
                        -- === CAP AT 100% ===
                        -- If the cast ends after the swing timer, clamp the value to 1.
                        -- This keeps the tick inside the bar (at the very end).
                        if calculatedPercent > 1 then 
                            calculatedPercent = 1 
                        end
                        
                        aura_env.tickPercent = calculatedPercent
                        aura_env.castWeaveActive = true
                    end
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- 2. INTERRUPT
    if event == "UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED" then
        local unit = select(1, ...)
        if unit == "player" then
            aura_env.tickPercent = -1
            aura_env.castWeaveActive = false
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return true
end

function()
    local cfg = _G.TBCHunterConfig or {}
    local region = aura_env.region
    
    -- === CPU OPTIMIZATION (EARLY EXIT) ===
    -- Abort instantly if the user is NOT in "Single Bar" mode (Value 1)
    if cfg.SWTMode ~= 1 then
        if region then region:Hide() end
        return false
    end
    -- =====================================
    
    -- Check if Cast Tick is globally disabled in custom options
    if cfg.swtCastTick == false then 
        if region then region:Hide() end
        return false 
    end
    
    -- Target the Single Bar
    local targetRegionName = "Swing Timer - Single Bar" 
    local parentRegion = WeakAuras.GetRegion(targetRegionName)
    
    -- Hide if parent bar is not found or not visible
    if not parentRegion or not parentRegion:IsVisible() then 
        if region then region:Hide() end
        return false 
    end
    
    -- SAFETY TIMEOUT: Prevent the tick from getting stuck after combat
    if aura_env.lastAutoStart and aura_env.autoSpeed then
        local swingEnd = aura_env.lastAutoStart + aura_env.autoSpeed
        if GetTime() > (swingEnd + 0.5) then
            region:Hide()
            return false
        end
    end
    
    -- DISPLAY & POSITIONING
    if aura_env.castWeaveActive and aura_env.tickPercent and aura_env.tickPercent > 0 then
        
        -- COLOR UPDATE
        if cfg.swtTickColor then
            local r, g, b, a = unpack(cfg.swtTickColor)
            if region.texture then region.texture:SetVertexColor(r, g, b, a) end
            if region.SetVertexColor then region:SetVertexColor(r, g, b, a) end
        else
            -- Fallback to white
            if region.texture then region.texture:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1, 1) end
        end
        
        region:Show()
        region:ClearAllPoints()
        
        local percent = aura_env.tickPercent
        if percent > 1 then percent = 1 end
        
        -- STANDARD MOVEMENT: Left to Right (Positive offset)
        region:SetPoint("CENTER", parentRegion, "LEFT", parentRegion.width * percent, 0)
        return true
    else
        region:Hide()
        return false
    end
end

    local function ScanTargetDebuff()

        for i = 1, 40 do

function()
    -- 1. Find the macro "AutoMD"
    local index = GetMacroIndexByName("AutoMD")
    
    -- If macro does not exist, return nothing
    if index == 0 then return "" end
    
    -- 2. Read the macro content
    local body = GetMacroBody(index)
    
    -- If macro is empty, return nothing
    if not body or body == "" then return "" end
    
    -- 3. Extract Name (between brackets @...)
    local name = string.match(body, "@(.-)]")
    
    -- If no name found inside brackets, return nothing
    if not name or name == "" then return "" end
    
    -- 4. Extract Class (hidden after dashes --)
    local classFilename = string.match(body, "%-%-(%a+)")
    
    -- 5. Define Color
    local colorStr = "ffffffff" -- Default White
    
    if classFilename and RAID_CLASS_COLORS[classFilename] then
        -- If hidden class found in macro, use it! (Persistent)
        colorStr = RAID_CLASS_COLORS[classFilename].colorStr
    else
        -- Fallback: Try to guess via current target if class is missing from macro
        local cleanName = string.match(name, "([^%-]+)") or name
        if UnitName("target") == cleanName then
            local _, c = UnitClass("target")
            if c and RAID_CLASS_COLORS[c] then 
                colorStr = RAID_CLASS_COLORS[c].colorStr 
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Clean name for display (remove realm if present)
    local cleanName = string.match(name, "([^%-]+)") or name
    
    return "|c" .. colorStr .. cleanName .. "|r"
end

-- 2. On s'abonne à la liste globale pour les mises à jour en direct (Options)
if _G.TBCHunter_Listeners then
    _G.TBCHunter_Listeners[aura_env.id] = aura_env.UpdateStyle
end

trigger.custom:
function(event)
    -- 1. SAFETY: Check if global config exists. 
    -- If not, return false (hide aura) or true (show default) depending on preference.
    local cfg = _G.TBCHunterConfig
    if not cfg then return false end -- Or return true if you want it visible by default
    
    -- 2. STYLE UPDATE (Fonts & Textures)
    -- We only run this heavy part when config changes or at login
    if event == "TBC_OPTIONS_UPDATE" or event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then
        local region = aura_env.region
        local LSM = LibStub("LibSharedMedia-3.0")
        
        if region then
            -- A. TEXTURE LOGIC (Only applies if aura is a Progress Bar)
            if cfg.globalTexture and region.regionType == "aurabar" and region.bar then
                local tex = LSM:Fetch("statusbar", cfg.globalTexture)
                if tex then 
                    region.bar:SetStatusBarTexture(tex)
                    -- Often useful to match the background too
                    if region.bg then region.bg:SetTexture(tex) end
                end
            end
            
            -- B. FONT LOGIC (Applies to all texts)
            if cfg.globalFont then
                local font = LSM:Fetch("font", cfg.globalFont)
                if font then
                    -- Helper to apply font keeping size/flags
                    local function SetFont(fs)
                        if fs and fs.SetFont and fs.GetFont then
                            local _, size, flags = fs:GetFont()
                            fs:SetFont(font, size, flags)
                        end
                    end
                    
                    -- Update standard texts
                    SetFont(region.text)
                    SetFont(region.timer)
                    SetFont(region.stacks)
                    
                    -- Update Custom Texts (SubRegions)
                    if region.subRegions then
                        for _, s in pairs(region.subRegions) do
                            if s.type == "subtext" then SetFont(s.text) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- 3. VISIBILITY LOGIC
    -- Adapts depending on the aura type
    
    -- For Swing Timer (Single):
    -- return cfg.SWTMode == 1
    
    -- For Swing Timer (Mirror):
    -- return cfg.SWTMode == 2
    
    -- For everything else (Mana, Castbar...):
    return true
end
